# TEMPO (20 · tempo)

A playable polyphonic synthesizer — oscillators, filter, echo, and a genuinely live oscilloscope.

- **Technique:** WEB AUDIO
- **Tags:** music, audio, interactive, synth, instrument, dark, tactile
- **Best for:** music tech; audio products; interactive demos
- **Fonts:** Chakra Petch, DM Sans
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chakra+Petch:wght@400;600;700&family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #17181d · #a06bff · #6bffc9
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers

## Signature effects
- `controls.ts`
  - `formatCutoff` — Cutoff readout: Hz shown as kHz with one decimal, e.g. "2.4kHz".
  - `formatEcho` — Echo readout: whole percent, e.g. "25%".
  - `knob(el: HTMLElement, out: HTMLElement, { min, max, value, format, onChange }: KnobOptions)` — Rotary knob driven by vertical pointer drag or arrow keys; the mark sweeps -135° to +135°.
  - `waveButtons(buttons: NodeListOf<HTMLButtonElement>, synth: Synth)` — Waveform selector: clicking a `.wv[data-w]` button marks it `.on` and sets the synth's oscillator type.
- `instrument.ts`
  - `initInstrument(root: HTMLElement)` — Wire up the instrument markup under `root` (`#synth`): synth engine, keys, knobs, waveform buttons, scope. Knob ranges and units come from the knobs' aria/`data-*` attributes, the default waveform from the `.wv.on` button. No audio context exists until the first key press.
- `keyboard.ts`
  - `keyboard(root: HTMLElement, synth: Synth, readout: HTMLElement)` — Make every `.key` under `root` playable by pointer and by its computer-keyboard key. Each key carries `data-note`, `data-freq` and `data-key`; `readout` shows the last note played. Notes start the audio context, so they must only trigger from user gestures (pointer/key events).
- `scope.ts`
  - `scope(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, synth: Synth)` — Oscilloscope: plots the synth's AnalyserNode time-domain data (2,048 samples) every frame. Before the audio engine exists it draws a gentle idle sine so the scope never looks dead.
- `synth.ts`
  - `Synth` — Polyphonic subtractive synth: oscillator voices → lowpass filter → [dry, feedback delay] → master → analyser → out. The AudioContext is created (and resumed) only from `noteOn`, which callers invoke from a user gesture.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<br>/<a>/<i> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** A playable note bound to a computer-keyboard key. */
export interface Note {
  /** Scientific pitch name shown in the readout, e.g. "C#4". */
  name: string;
  /** Frequency in Hz. */
  freq: number;
  /** Computer-keyboard key that plays it (also printed on the key). */
  key: string;
}

/** A sharp/flat key drawn over the gap between two white keys. */
export interface BlackNote extends Note {
  /** Index of the white key just left of this black key. */
  after: number;
}

export interface KnobContent {
  /** Caption under the knob. */
  label: string;
  /** aria-label of the slider. */
  ariaLabel: string;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  /** Initial value. */
  value: number;
  /** Unit printed after the readout number (e.g. "kHz", "%"). */
  unit: string;
}

export interface Waveform {
  /** Button label, e.g. "SAW". */
  label: string;
  /** Web Audio oscillator type. */
  type: OscillatorType;
}

export interface Spec {
  title: string;
  body: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Logo in nav + footer; wrap the accented letter in <i>. */
  logoHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    headingHtml: string;
    subHtml: string;
  };
  synth: {
    /** Filter cutoff knob (Hz, drives the lowpass filter). Readout is shown in kHz. */
    cutoff: KnobContent;
    /** Echo mix knob (0–100, drives the delay send level). */
    echo: KnobContent;
    waveforms: Waveform[];
    /** Waveform selected at load; must be one of `waveforms[].type`. */
    defaultWave: OscillatorType;
    keys: {
      white: Note[];
      black: BlackNote[];
    };
    /** Status line under the keys. */
    status: {
      ready: string;
      model: string;
      /** Last-played-note readout before any key is pressed. */
      idleNote: string;
    };
    hintHtml: string;
  };
  engine: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    specs: Spec[];
  };
  why: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    body: string;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
